## Earnie 2.6.2-beta.1

Community **pre-release** for final tests before official **2.6.2** (hotfix line; follows declined **2.6.1** candidate). Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **Energy-Charts 503 / Monitor crash:** live Day-Ahead fallback no longer `NameError`s on `MARKET_ZONE_CH`; aWATTar is used when Energy-Charts is unavailable (e.g. HTTP 503)
- Includes everything from the **2.6.1** line: [#24](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/issues/24) hourly CSV ZOH + HA tariffs path, EEG catalog cleanup, unified power sign convention

### Please check

- **Monitor / Live:** with Energy-Charts down or 503, prices still load via aWATTar (warning in log; no red exception on Monitor)
- **HA / Loxone battery sign:** same checks as **2.6.1-beta.2** — battery power **positive while discharging**

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.2-beta.1` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`) after you approve **promote**
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.6.0**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
